candidate_names.A1: road march for a long road journey
candidate_names.C0: weapon lock or unfold on its own

anchors.0: removes a baseline-v2 action without carrying it out later, every time

C.name: opportunity cost and latency (cheaper scores higher)

anchors.3: the action listed for the population (observed) and its effect documented
anchors.4: the action accepted (observed) and its effect documented
anchors.5: the effect observed in project records
activations in all 8 frozen scenarios of H0 and in at least 3 archetypes

anchors.3: a two-step sequence of one mechanism
anchors.4: one action type, replacing nothing, but needing memory
anchors.5: one action type, only on units baseline-v2 leaves idle

anchors.3: a documented effect conditional on enemy behaviour
anchors.4: a documented effect on a scoring mechanism of smaller size or in some activations
anchors.5: a documented effect on a scoring mechanism (losses, occupation, fire) of at least a 2-point table modifier or a 30% time saving, in most activations

anchors.4: needs both seats' views, which the existing capture records
anchors.5: the intermediate mechanism is a seat-observable field change, measurable per activation by the existing full-step capture

anchors.1: an input not in the seat view
anchors.2: an input reconstructed from history the seat cannot keep
anchors.3: an input whose semantics is unverified
anchors.4: inputs derived from seat fields, setup data and documented constants (class 2)
anchors.5: every trigger input a seat field (class 1)

anchors.2: a known-unsafe case excluded only by an unverified rule
anchors.3: a bounded irreversible window (at most 75 s), no known unsafe case
anchors.5: documented free reversal, no known unsafe case

selection: highest weighted score among candidates meeting both mandatory minimums (O >= 4, S >= 3); ties by L, then S, then I, then pool order; none if no candidate is eligible

list: each weight plus or minus 0.05, others rescaled (16)
every flagged UNKNOWN cell at 0 and at 5 (2)

unknown_rule: a cell whose decisive evidence is UNKNOWN is capped at 2 and flagged; never given a favourable value
